name: Moltinus

attributes.attribute: name shares the root with the sheep words
known from two inscriptions and not mapped to a Roman deity

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Moltinus is a Continental Celtic god. His name shares its root with the words that name the sheep, the English word mutton and the French word mouton. The name has been read as a ram. Moltinus is known from only two inscriptions. Unlike many Celtic gods, he was not mapped by the Romans to one of their own deities.
objective: Document Moltinus, the Continental ram god.
key_results: Record the sheep root of the name.
